cases.name: argv_inline_0
args:
assert(jsonStringify(argv()) == ("[\"\",\"中文🙂\",\"--json\",\"-e\",\"--\",\"--help\",\"test\",\"a b\",\"\${x}\"]"), "args")
let old=argv()
old[0]="changed"
assert(argv()[0]=="", "fresh")
let f=argv
assert(f()==argv(),"alias")
let fs=[f]
assert(fs[0]()==argv(),"container")
let h={"f":f}
assert(h["f"]()==argv(),"struct_call")
assert(map(fn(g){g()},[f,f])==[argv(),argv()],"hof")
print("ok")
